title: Maximum Sum Subarray of Fixed Size
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the maximum sum of any contiguous subarray of length exactly k. It is guaranteed that 1 <= k <= len(nums).
reference_solution:
def max_sum_fixed_window(nums, k):
    window_sum = sum(nums[:k])
    best = window_sum
    for i in range(k, len(nums)):
        window_sum += nums[i] - nums[i - k]
        best = max(best, window_sum)
    return best
hints: You need the sum of every contiguous block of k elements; recomputing each sum from scratch is wasteful.
Maintain a running window sum: as the window slides right by one, add the new element and subtract the one that fell out of the window.
Initialize window_sum to the sum of the first k elements, then for i from k to len(nums)-1 do window_sum += nums[i] - nums[i-k] and track the max.
